review.why: Requests a code review from a fresh subagent with precise context: when to ask, how to fill the template and how to act on the findings.
review.summary: Lists when review is mandatory (after each task, after a major feature, before merging) or optional. The steps are to get base and head commit ids, dispatch a reviewer subagent with a filled template, then fix critical and important issues, note minor ones and push back with evidence when the reviewer is wrong. It includes rationalizations to avoid and red flags.
strengths: Reviewer gets crafted context, never the whole session history
Clear severity handling: critical now, important before proceeding
Short table of excuses for skipping review
cautions: Needs a harness that can dispatch subagents
The reviewer template is in a file not read here
